    fixtureRank b < fixtureRank a

private lemma edge_reach (e : Fin 9) :
    fixtureGraph.DReach (fixtureGraph.source e) (fixtureGraph.target e)

    fixtureGraph.source e = 5 ↔ fixtureGraph.target e = 5
